import collections
def analyze(k):
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(I,bg)
    iso=[c for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    print('=====',k,'bg',bg,'niso',len(iso))
    for c in cs:
        if len(set(v for _,_,v in c))>=2 and len(c)>1:
            mk=[(r,cc) for r,cc,v in c if collections.Counter(v for _,_,v in c)[v]==1][0]
            mc=v
            shp=[(r-mk[0],cc-mk[1],v) for r,cc,v in c if (r,cc)!=(mk[0],mk[1])]
            for seed in iso:
                sr,sc=seed[0]
                ok=all(0<=sr+a<len(O) and 0<=sc+b<len(O[0]) and O[sr+a][sc+b]==v for a,b,v in shp)
                mir=[(-a,-b,v) for a,b,v in shp]
                okm=all(0<=sr+a<len(O) and 0<=sc+b<len(O[0]) and O[sr+a][sc+b]==v for a,b,v in mir)
                print(f'  seed{seed} color{I[sr][sc]} direct={ok} mirror={okm}')
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,8)]:
    analyze(k)

    I=G[n+' input']; O=G[n+' output']
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_g(I,bg)

    for s in seeds:

        seedstamps.setdefault(s,near)
    ok=all(len(seedstamps[s])==sum(1 for rr,cc in [(p[:2]) for p in Dlist if True]) for s in seeds)
    return seedstamps

def solve(I, mir=False):
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    tmap={}
    for tc in [c for c in cs if len(c)>1]:
        mr=min(r for r,_,_ in tc); mcd=min(cc for _,cc,_ in tc)
        rel=[(r-mr,cc-mcd,v) for r,cc,v in tc]
        cnt=collections.Counter(v for _,_,v in rel)
        mk=[(r,cc,v) for r,cc,v in rel if cnt[v]==1]
        if len(mk)!=1: continue
        mv=mk[0][2]; (mrr,mcr)=mk[0][:2]
        shape=[((rel_r if not mir else -rel_r), (rel_c if not mir else -rel_c)- (mcr if False else 0), v) for rel_r,rel_c,v in rel]
        shape=[(rel_r-(mrr if not mir else mrr), -(rel_c-mcr) if mir else rel_c-mcr, v) for rel_r,rel_c,v in rel]
        # drop the marker cell position: keep all but the one matching marker coords
        tmap[mv]=[[(rel_r-(mrr if not mir else mrr), rel_c-mcr if not mir else -(rel_c-mcr), v) for rel_r,rel_c,v in rel if not (rel_r==mrr and rel_c==mcr)]]
    for sr,sc in seeds:
        v=I[sr][sc]

                    O[rr][cc]=w
    return O

def solve(i, orient):
    J=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; K=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    H,W=len(J),len(J[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in J for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(J,bg); seeds=[c[0][:2] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    tmap={}
    for tc in cs:
        if len(tc)<=1: continue
        cnts=collections.Counter(x[2] for x in tc)
        mks=[(r,c,vv) for r,c,vv in tc if cnts[vv]==1]
        for (mrkr,mkcr,mv) in mks:
            base=[(r-mrkr,c-mkcr,v2) for r,c,v2 in tc if (r,c)!=(mrkr,mkcr)]
            tmap.setdefault(mv,[]).append(base)
    O=[row[:] for row in J]
    for sr,sc in sorted(seeds):

            if placed: break

import collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for i in range(1,9):
    J=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; exp=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    ih,jj=len(J),len(J[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for row in J for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    diffs=[(r,c,int(exp[r][c])) for r in range(ih) for c in range(jj) if exp[r][c]!=J[r][c]]
    # try to find a single dihedral transform+stamp (of some component) that fits: test each seed independently first
    # For demo1: print full diff picture
    for r in range(ih):
        line=''.join('.' if exp[r][c]==J[r][c] else str(exp[r][c]) for c in range(jj))
        if '.' not in line or line.count('.')<len(line)-4: pass
    print('demo',i,'ndiff',len(diffs),'sample:',diffs[:10])
